title: Integral completed-pullback comparison data and signed shift normalization
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme morphism $g:X\to Y$. Use the integral reduction tower, its good K-flat representatives and its mapping-cocone pullback functor $F_g$ from [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], together with the integral and constructible pullbacks of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Use the fixed completed coefficient transport and finite evaluation maps of [def-a1-integral-completed-pullback-interfaces] and the completed pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. All coefficient rings and scheme sites have their recorded universes.

For a representative $P$, put $B_n(P)=\operatorname{Res}_n g_n^*(P_n)$ and $B(P)=\prod_nB_n(P)$. Define $\operatorname{roosEnd}(P)=1-s$ using the transition maps of this tower. Define $\operatorname{levelShift}_{P,r,n}:B_n(P[r])\simeq B_n(P)[r]$ by the termwise reduction, exact finite pullback and restriction comparisons; define $\operatorname{productShift}_{P,r}:B(P[r])\simeq B(P)[r]$ by their product and the product-preservation comparison for shift. The predicate $\operatorname{ShiftCoordinates}(c)$ on a coherent shift structure $c$ for $F_g$ requires, at every degree and every $r\in\mathbf Z$, that its mapping-cocone comparison is $(x,y)\mapsto(x,(-1)^r y)$ under this product comparison, equivalently $(y,x)\mapsto((-1)^r y,x)$. The predicate $\operatorname{ShiftDescent}(c,d)$ on such a $c$ and a coherent shift structure $d$ for $Lg^*$ requires that, for every good representative $P$ and every $r$, $P[r]$ is good and the representative computation isomorphisms intertwine $d$ with the localization of $c$, including the canonical shift comparison of the derived localization functor.

Define $\operatorname{Comparison}_{\ell,E,g}$ to be the type of the following data and equations, without asserting that it is inhabited: (1) every object complete in the recorded Roos sense [def-weil-derived-complete] is intrinsically complete [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]; (2) finite module pullback isomorphisms between the integral and completed presentations, preserving their tensor-unit generators; (3) shift structures $c,d$ with $\operatorname{ShiftCoordinates}(c)$ and $\operatorname{ShiftDescent}(c,d)$; (4) coefficient-linear isomorphisms $\gamma_K:Lg^*K\simeq Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$ on complete objects, natural in every derived arrow, whose inverse followed by every integral derived-limit projection agrees with the completed projection under the specified finite representative comparison; (5) for every integer $r$, the isomorphisms $\gamma_{K[r]}$ and $\gamma_K[r]$ agree under $d$ and the recorded completed-pullback shift. The field helpers are the coefficient transports on modules, complexes and derived categories; the two finite pullback functors, their generator-normalization predicate and complex comparison; the representative computation and projection maps; the completed tower comparison and projection; the level and product shifts and Roos endomorphism; the two pullback presentations and completeness predicate. These are the existing constructions in IntegralCompletedComparison, with no replacement or choice of comparison data.
